SMO_SDK_RETRY: Python SDK (`smo_sdk`) in an rApp: `off` sends every SDK call once (no repeat after a transport error or a 429/502/503/504); `on` (the default) repeats them per the policy in `sdk/README.md`. Any other value stops the rApp at start. SMO modules do not read it. The Go and Java SDKs have no such variable (their policy is set in code).
SMO_SDK_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS: Python SDK: milliseconds of the first wait before a repeat (default 200); each following wait doubles, up to `SMO_SDK_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS`, with jitter between half and all of it. A whole number of at least 1.
SMO_SDK_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS: Python SDK: how many times in all a call is sent when it keeps failing for a transient reason (default 4, the first send included; 1 means never repeat). A whole number of at least 1.
SMO_SDK_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS: Python SDK: the longest wait between two sends, in milliseconds (default 5000), before jitter. A server's `Retry-After` may make one wait longer, up to 30 s. At least `SMO_SDK_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS`.
